d: Nvidia has reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as its President and CEO, reversing its decision to accept his resignation just days earlier. The dramatic comeback follows revelations about multiple extramarital affairs, including an alleged relationship with a businesswoman suspected by US authorities of having links to Chinese intelligence. Beijing denies the espionage allegations. Huang stepped down on November 12, but mounting pressure from employees, shareholders, business partners and US President Donald Trump fuelled calls for his return.
